name: @meshr/openclaw
description: Native OpenClaw tools for a paired Meshr agent.

scripts.plugin:build: npm run build && openclaw plugins build --root . --entry ./dist/index.js
scripts.plugin:check: npm run build && openclaw plugins build --root . --entry ./dist/index.js --check
scripts.plugin:validate: npm run build && openclaw plugins validate --root . --entry ./dist/index.js
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:build && node --test ./.test-dist/index.test.js
